purpose: Prepare a bounded intake path for the first true host/export candidate without replacing the current actual_export slot, promoting any reference candidate, or declaring actual_export_only gate close.

canonical_candidate_intake_path.rule: Place exactly one future true host/export candidate record here for dry-run validation. Do not wire it into the current slot until a separate supervisor review explicitly approves slot replacement testing.
canonical_candidate_intake_path.why_separate: The inbox is a candidate intake path, not the current SSOT. Validator dry-runs should use --override-record against this path while preserving the existing current slot.

must_not_be: synthetic reconstruction without raw export provenance
manually normalized record without transformation history

required_envelope_fields.candidate_id: Stable id for this candidate intake attempt.

provenance.source_system: Host system or product that emitted the export.
provenance.export_origin: Concrete export origin such as workspace/project/repository/run source.
provenance.export_method: How the export was captured, for example CLI export, API export, downloaded JSON, or host-generated archive.
provenance.raw_export_ref: Path or durable reference to the raw captured export before VectorFL normalization.
provenance.captured_by: Actor or adapter that captured the export.
provenance.captured_at: Timestamp from capture time, preferably source timestamp plus local receipt timestamp.
provenance.transformation_history: List of transformations from raw export into the four-surface candidate shape.

capture_context.host_runtime_relation: How the host/runtime that emitted the record relates to the VectorFL Paper pilot.
capture_context.export_scope: What subset of host data was exported and what was intentionally omitted.
capture_context.redaction_note: Whether any field was redacted and whether redaction affects validator judgment.
capture_context.operator_note: Short human-readable note about why this candidate is being tested.

honesty_declaration.raw_export_available: Must be true or the candidate remains hold.
honesty_declaration.synthetic_fields: List any synthetic or inferred fields; empty list is preferred.
honesty_declaration.normalization_boundary: Explain exactly what was normalized and what host grammar was preserved.

validation_path.expected_validator_reading: A true host/export candidate may become candidate_for_reopen_validation or candidate_for_gate_close, but the dry-run result alone does not replace the current slot.

classify_as_reopen_candidate_when: all four required surfaces are present
honesty declaration separates the candidate from reference-derived or local fixture material
raw export provenance and capture timestamp are present
the record provides enough result or decision material to exercise a real reopen reading
keep_hold_when: redaction prevents shape or mapping judgment
validator result is fail or no_change
validator result is partial but reopen evidence remains uncertain
slot_replacement_reviewable_only_when: candidate was validated by override-record without mutating current slot
gate_effect is candidate_for_gate_close or a supervisor explicitly accepts candidate_for_reopen_validation as a pre-slot-replacement review input
raw export provenance, capture context, and transformation history are complete
a separate supervisor decision manifest authorizes a slot replacement test
does_not_count_as_gate_close: comparison manifest says validator is stable enough for merge testing
legacy surface can display the comparison layer
candidate inbox file exists without raw export provenance

closeout_note.what_the_intake_contract_is: A single true host/export candidate envelope plus the four required host surfaces and explicit provenance/honesty declarations.
closeout_note.where_actual_candidates_should_be_placed: runtime/manifests/vectorfl_paper_actual_export_candidate_inbox_latest_v0.json, reserved as a future candidate inbox and kept separate from the current actual export slot.
closeout_note.how_candidates_are_validated: Run the existing validator with --override-record against the inbox path, then read the dry-run result and comparison manifest before any supervisor decision.
closeout_note.what_remains_forbidden: No current slot replacement, no reference candidate promotion, no gate close declaration, no proper surface modification, no UI layer, and no full legacy merge.
